subject: MIN function
notes: REFUTER RE-EXAMINED AND SUSTAINED — the one row that survived attack, and the format DIAGRAM was rendered from the PDF rather than trusted from the transcription (CLAUDE.md rule 1: a general format is a load-bearing diagram). Printed folio 888 / PDF page 918 renders as `FUNCTION MIN ( { argument-1 } … )` with FUNCTION and MIN both UNDERLINED and nothing bracketed — exactly what specs/ISO_COBOL.md §15.63.2 carries, so the transcription is faithful and no falsely-restrictive OCR residue is in play here. The grammar rule `functionCall : FUNCTION functionName (LPAREN functionArgList? RPAREN)? refModPart*` is a deliberate SUPERSET — the parenthesised group is optional there and the per-function arity is the binder's job. For MIN the catalog row is Variadic with a minimum of 1 (`Add(new("MIN", IntrinsicType.Numeric, IntrinsicArity.Variadic, 1, inf, "p", "MinScaled", ...))`) and the binder enforces it, so the composite behaviour matches the printed format: FUNCTION required, MIN required, the parenthesised list required, at least one argument required, repetition unbounded. The repeat-brace `…` also picks up §15.3's ALL-subscript expansion, which works. ⚠ RESIDUE (unchanged, and it is a corpus gap not a conformance defect): no spec-derived test pins the two REJECTION shapes (bare `FUNCTION MIN`, empty `FUNCTION MIN()`) — test-ref is deliberately left EMPTY rather than closed on the differential. ⚠ SCOPE NOTE the refuter adds: §15.63.1's TYPE TABLE (Index ⇒ Index, All arguments integer ⇒ Integer) is visible on the same rendered page and is NOT covered by any rule in this batch — the catalog hardcodes IntrinsicType.Numeric and the binder only ever re-derives Alphanumeric/National. Whether the Integer and Index rows of that table are honoured is an UNADJUDICATED row, and it should be added to the inventory rather than assumed closed by this FMT verdict. EVIDENCE: PDF page rendered: `python scripts/spec/clause_page.py 15.63.1 15.63.2 15.63.3` → PDF page 918 / printed folio 888; `python scripts/render-spec-page.py 918` → E:/Temp/spec_p918.png, read and compared against the transcription. Prior probes retained (all at --std 2023 against the built cobol.exe): (1) bare `COMPUTE R = FUNCTION MIN` → `error COBOL1504: FUNCTION MIN takes at least 1 argument(s); 0 given (ISO §15.3)`; (2) `FUNCTION MIN()` → the same COBOL1504; (3) one argument → 2; (4) twelve arguments → 0; (5) `FUNCTION MIN(E(ALL))` over `05 E PIC S9(4) OCCURS 4` holding 9/4/7/2 → +2; (6) `01 MIN PIC X(3)` is still a legal user-defined word with `FUNCTION MIN(5 2 9)` resolving as the intrinsic in the same program; (7) keyword-omitted form with `REPOSITORY. FUNCTION MIN INTRINSIC.` works. REFUTER-ADDED PROBES, E:/Temp/minrefute/fmt.cob (PROGRAM-ID MINRFFMT) — four shapes the adjudication never exercised, all correct: separators inside the repeated list `FUNCTION MIN(9, 4; 7)` → SEP=00000D (+4); ARITHMETIC-EXPRESSION arguments (§15.3 type 10) `FUNCTION MIN(A + 1, B * 2)` with A=10 B=3 → EXPR=00000F (+6); a NESTED function-identifier as an argument `FUNCTION MIN(FUNCTION MAX(1 2) 3)` → NEST=00000B (+2); the keyword-omitted form with a SUBSCRIPTED argument, the shape most at risk of being re-parsed as a subscripted data item, `COMPUTE R = MIN(E(1) 5)` with E(1)=9 → KWSUB=00000E (+5). And E:/Temp/minrefute/misc.cob: reference modification of the function result, `MOVE FUNCTION MIN(P3 P5)(1:2) TO RS` with P3 PIC X(3) VALUE "AB" → REFMOD=[AB  ].
